Conference identity · Web + print

CreativePro Week

An energetic identity. An organized experience.

A conference design exploration that pairs an expressive identity with clear access to speakers, session tracks, and event information across digital and printed formats.

Format
Web, mobile, poster, brochure
Focus
Visual identity, information hierarchy, UI design
01 Overview02 Decisions03 Design04 Reflection

01 / The context

The experience behind the screens.

CreativePro Week is presented as an online conference for creative professionals. The project includes a landing page, speaker profiles, a multitrack schedule, mobile layouts, and promotional print materials. The original artwork depicts the May 17–21, 2021 event.

The design challenge

The event needs to communicate creative energy without making a dense program hard to understand. Promotional surfaces and informational screens serve different purposes, but still need to feel like one event.

02 / Design decisions

What shaped
the experience.

01

Build a recognizable visual vocabulary

Pink, orange, and lime, oversized vertical typography, and design-grid motifs establish an expressive conference identity.

02

Let information change the pace

Warmer, quieter backgrounds give speaker biographies and the schedule room to be read after the high-energy landing page.

03

Adapt the system across formats

The same visual language connects the mobile menu, event pages, brochure, poster, and outdoor placement.

04 / Reflection

What this
work brings together.

The project demonstrates a visual system that can be expressive at first glance and more restrained where people need to read and compare information. The digital screens are design explorations rather than a live registration service.
